newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks fall in lacklustre London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks fall in lacklustre London trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London fell on Thursday in quiet, low volume trade with no stock standing out from the pack, traders said.
"It has been very quiet," said one trader.
The Hang Seng London reference index fell 15.56 points, or 0.09 percent, to 16,482.15 points.
The Hang Seng in Hong Kong closed 14.78 points higher, or 0.09 percent, at 16,497.71.
"Hong Kong is taking a bit of a breather," one trader said, adding that there had been some profit taking in the property sector.
Another trader said there had been some interest in the Chinese companies traded on the exchange.
The market had been characterised by classic holiday season lack of interest, one trader said. The Hang Seng will be closed on Monday for Sino-Japanese War Victory Day.
